aboutGame.title: What is Gundam Battle Operation 3?
paragraphs: Gundam Battle Operation 3 is Bandai Namco's free-to-play, large-scale team combat game for PlayStation 5 and PC. Pilots take mercenary mobile suits into online battles built around the Raid, General, and Support class triangle, mixing ranged pressure, stun timing, melee follow-ups, and boost management.

The October 28, 2026 reveal confirmed crossplay between PS5 and Steam, a new SP Skill system, a social Base Camp hub, and launch units drawn from Mobile Suit Gundam, The 08th MS Team, 0083: Stardust Memory, and SEED. A release date has not been announced.

faq.title: Gundam Battle Operation 3 FAQ
faq.description: Quick answers about Gundam Battle Operation 3 platforms, combat, network tests, and launch plans.

items.question: What is Gundam Battle Operation 3?
items.answer: Gundam Battle Operation 3 is Bandai Namco's free-to-play team combat game for PS5 and PC. Players pilot mobile suits in large-scale online battles built around the Raid, General, and Support class triangle.

items.question: Which platforms will Gundam Battle Operation 3 support?
items.answer: Gundam Battle Operation 3 is confirmed for PlayStation 5 and Steam. The two platforms share crossplay, and no PS4, Xbox, or Nintendo version has been announced.

items.question: When does Gundam Battle Operation 3 release?
items.answer: Bandai Namco has not announced a release date for Gundam Battle Operation 3. A Japan-only cross-play network test is scheduled for November 20 and 22, with a wider open test planned.

items.question: Which mobile suits are confirmed for Gundam Battle Operation 3 at launch?
items.answer: Gundam Battle Operation 3 draws its launch roster from Mobile Suit Gundam, The 08th MS Team, 0083: Stardust Memory, and SEED. Two to three more Alternative series are planned in year one.

items.question: How does combat work in Gundam Battle Operation 3?
items.answer: Gundam Battle Operation 3 combines ranged stun buildup, melee follow-ups, boost management, and the Raid, General, and Support class triangle. The new SP Skill system adds a match-swinging tactical option.

items.question: Do I need to play Battle Operation 2 before Gundam Battle Operation 3?
items.answer: No. Gundam Battle Operation 3 is a standalone free-to-play entry, though experience with the earlier game's class roles and boost timing provides a useful head start.
